changelog: v1.3.4: Fix TPROXY breakage on reconnect. route_localnet=1 is now always set on apply and never reset on cleanup (TPROXY requires it; previously a sysctl_hardening=false config silently lost TPROXY delivery after the second cleanup). Add 20s settling grace and stable-new requirement to the route-change detector so transient rmnet flicker after data toggle can no longer trigger a teardown storm.
